# Mingji Liu

> Personal website of Mingji Liu: poems, essays, travel writing, reviews, and photography. All content by Mingji Liu, licensed CC BY 4.0 (reuse permitted with attribution to Mingji Liu).

## Sections

- [About Mingji Liu](https://mingjiliu.com/about/): biography and contact
- [Poems](https://mingjiliu.com/poems/): original poetry by Mingji Liu
- [Essays](https://mingjiliu.com/essays/): essays and reflections
- [Travel](https://mingjiliu.com/travel/): travel writing with photography
- [Reviews](https://mingjiliu.com/reviews/): book and other reviews
- [Publications](https://mingjiliu.com/publications/): academic publications
